@graph.name: Land cover inside Kras (SI3000276), CORINE 2000-2018
@graph.description: Area of each CORINE Land Cover class inside the Natura 2000 site SI3000276 in 2000, 2006, 2012 and 2018, and the mapped changes between inventories, clipped to the site boundary and measured in EPSG:3035. Change is taken from the CLC-Change layers, as the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service advises, not by subtracting status layers. Minimum mapping unit 25 ha for status layers and 5 ha for change layers; minimum width of linear elements 100 m (EEA service description). CLC 1990 covers the site but is not used: CLMS publishes no consistent 1990 accounting layer. CORINE classes are land cover, not Annex I habitat types.
@graph.creditText: BMD Single Access Point prototype (A. Fouilloux), whose data builders are reused here (vendored in pipeline/builders/); FAIR2Adapt (FAIR to Adapt to Climate Change), European Commission grant 101188256, which funded the prototype code
